Phobos.Dosing.Defs.PhobosDiseaseClassDef.label: bacterial
Phobos.Dosing.Defs.PhobosDiseaseClassDef.description: Caused by bacteria: plague, wound infection, cholera, dysentery, pneumonia. Antibiotics act on it.

Phobos.Dosing.Defs.PhobosDiseaseClassDef.label: viral
Phobos.Dosing.Defs.PhobosDiseaseClassDef.description: Caused by a virus: flu, and the scaria and necroa viruses. Antibiotics do nothing for it.

Phobos.Dosing.Defs.PhobosDiseaseClassDef.label: protozoan
Phobos.Dosing.Defs.PhobosDiseaseClassDef.description: Caused by single-celled parasites carried by insects: malaria and sleeping sickness.

Phobos.Dosing.Defs.PhobosDiseaseClassDef.label: worms
Phobos.Dosing.Defs.PhobosDiseaseClassDef.description: Caused by parasitic worms, or their like from another world: gut worms, muscle parasites, exoworms.

Phobos.Dosing.Defs.PhobosDiseaseClassDef.label: mechanites
Phobos.Dosing.Defs.PhobosDiseaseClassDef.description: Caused by microscopic machines, not germs: no drug made for a living thing acts on them.
